Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary from today's discovery:
- Primary workload: chat summarization + retrieval-augmented generation for help center (~80% of tokens).
- Current pilot: ~5M tokens/month. Expected production ramp to 20-30M tokens/month over 6 months, with peaks ~40M.
- Latency SLO: ~200-400ms p95; we discussed dedicated capacity for consistent p95.

Pricing / unit-econ items we discussed I wanted to capture: 
- Target $/1M tokens the team wants to stay near: you mentioned ~ $900-1200 / 1M tokens as a target band (confirm please).
- Budget range for FY27: you flagged $20k-40k/month as a rough budget range (confirm needed).

Action items I proposed on the call:
1) Please confirm the economic buyer / budget owner and the finance approver for contract sign-off.
2) Send any internal volume forecast you can share (next 6-12 months) so I can model unit economics and discounts.
3) I will share a pricing worksheet with three scenarios (baseline, optimized batching/caching, reserved capacity).

Attachments: Redwood-pricing-worksheet-1M-token-model.xlsx (pricing workbook) - attached for transparency; I filled in the worksheet with the numbers we discussed.

Proposed next meeting: 30-minute pricing review (Marissa + Alex + Maya or finance lead + Aditya (AE)) - Wed or Thu next week. What works for you?

Thanks -

- Budget: we have a preliminary budget band of $18k-35k/month for inference (inclusive of any infra/managed service) - final number requires VP Finance sign-off.
- Target $/1M tokens: internally we're aiming for ~$1,000 / 1M tokens as a procurement target. If Redwood can get us under $900 in reserved scenario that will make Procurement & Finance much happier.
